title: Operations platform for a logistics network
challenge: Dispatch teams juggled spreadsheets, radio calls, and a legacy portal that could not scale with new routes.
outcome: A unified web app for routing, status, and reporting — cutting handoff time and giving leadership live visibility.

title: Secure patient-facing portal
challenge: Patients struggled to book visits and access records; staff spent hours on phone support for basic tasks.
outcome: A responsive portal with appointments, messaging, and clear privacy controls — launched on schedule with IT hardening.

title: E-commerce refresh for a retail group
challenge: An outdated storefront and disconnected inventory tools slowed campaigns and confused customers.
outcome: A modern storefront, inventory integrations, and a marketing-ready CMS so merchandising and SEO teams move faster.
